# Eval inventory — every quantitative constraint, extracted

**GENERATED by `scripts/build/build_eval_inventory.py` — do not edit.**
This is the one deliberate exception to "references/ is hand-written":
an inventory is a table, not prose, and a hand-written copy of some one
hundred and eighty numbers is the drift class this repository has fixed
twenty-six times. Regenerate after any checker change; `--check` in CI
refuses a stale render.

What each tier means: a **gate** fails the run; **graded** prints FAIL
and does not fail the run; **reported** carries no predicate. The
`stated in references/` column is a rough textual cross-check — CODE
ONLY means the number appears in no reference file, which is exactly
the hidden-constraint condition this inventory exists to surface.

## Rendered-layout verdicts (`inspect_layout.py --deliverable`)

All of these **gate** a pre-delivery run. `deliverable_verdicts`
is the authority; five files once counted this list four
different ways.

`collision`, `content_hidden`, `content_spill`, `datum`, `figure_clipped`, `figure_distorts`, `figure_viewbox`, `footer_baseline`, `footer_wrap`, `page_height`, `reserve_overspent`, `role_split`, `starved_column`, `visual_absent`

## Evals thresholds (`evals/thresholds.json`)

Status: **REPORTED, NOT GATING** — see the file's `status_note` for why these report rather than gate.

| metric | direction | genre bars | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| figures_per_content_page | floor | consulting 0.5; internal —; marketing 0.5; sales 0.5; training 0.5 | calibrated/declined/provisional |
| list_items_per_content_page | ceiling | consulting 2.0; internal 2.0; marketing 2.0; sales 2.0; training 2.0 | calibrated/provisional |
| prose_only_share | ceiling | consulting 0.333; internal 0.333; marketing 0.333; sales 0.333; training 0.333 | calibrated/provisional |
| visual_share_median | floor | consulting 50; internal 50; marketing 50; sales 50; training 30 | inherited |

`min_content_pages` = 8 — below it, per-page ratios report `too few pages` rather than a verdict.
